فللت (form I)

# فَلَلْتِ (falalti) /fa.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of فَلَّ (falla)
# فُلِلْتُ (fuliltu) /fu.lil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of فَلَّ (falla)
# فُلِلْتَ (fulilta) /fu
